_comment: Qwen3-4B arm -- the 3 family, not 3.5. Isolates parameter count from model generation: same hermes tool-call format, same 152k vocab and no vision tower as the Qwen3-8B everything was measured on. Qwen3.5-4B was rejected because it emitted 10.5x more completion tokens (median 89 vs 20), making its rollout 1.9x SLOWER in wall clock than the larger 8B and cancelling the FLOPs advantage.
